issues.description: The return type of PersonService.getAllPersons differs between the template/problem expectation and the solution: the template and the problem statement expect a List<Person> to be returned for the GET /persons endpoint, but the solution's PersonService.getAllPersons returns a Set<Person>. At the same time PersonResource in the solution declares ResponseEntity<List<Person>> and forwards the service result directly, creating a type mismatch. This inconsistency breaks the intended contract (and the instruction in the problem to not change PersonService attributes) and would confuse or block students implementing the endpoints.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type of PersonService.getAllPersons with the problem specification and template (use List<Person>). Update the solution's PersonService.getAllPersons to return a List<Person> (and return an immutable or new List after sorting), or alternatively change PersonResource to accept and return a Set consistently — preferably change the service to return List<Person> so it matches the problem statement and the template contract and preserves the instruction not to change PersonService attributes.
